geography: Norway; resident and non-resident employees; all ages; both sexes
reference_period: Middle month of each quarter of 2025

metrics.Lonsstakere: Employees in people; occupation of main job
metrics.HeltidsEkvMnd: Full-time equivalents (monthly work units); not actual annual hours worked

limitations: Four quarterly snapshots do not constitute an observed annual FTE measure.
Use only four-digit occupation rows for aggregation; parents and control totals overlap.
Unspecified occupations must remain visible and must not be assigned zero demand.
Cells of one and two are replaced by zero or three for privacy; aggregation can differ from control totals.
Occupation reporting changed materially between 2024 Q4 and 2025 Q1.
Missing values must remain unknown rather than zero.
